data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: 3 sub-tracks remaining after PR #221 closed Track A: (B) test-write-cycle-ledger.sh intermittent — uses mktemp -d isolation (disproves /tmp race); likely the concurrent-write test (line ~130, 3 parallel writes) has a non-atomic assertion window. (C) test-gha-scanner-prompt-contract.sh SIGPIPE at line ~95 — verify the echo|grep -q fix pattern is applied. (D) test-dso-shim-subdir-dispatch.sh TIMEOUT >120s — CPU contention under MAX_PARALLEL=8, may need timeout guard or parallelism reduction. Classification: MODERATE — three independent sub-issues. Recommend splitting into 3 separate tickets post-triage. Leaving OPEN; not autonomously closed since no single-commit code fix lands all three.
